description: Amazon Research ST: amazon/product Detail API.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number; multiple ASINs separated by commas, up to 10, for example, `B0088PUEPK,B00U26V4VQ`.

includeTrend.description: Whether trend data is included: `1` does, `2` does not. By default, the trend of the last 15 days is returned.

queryTrendEndDate.description: Trend expiration date, format `yyyy-MM-dd`. When specifying a query range exceeding 15 days, the deduction will be doubled.
